require "json" require "serialize"
local COWBAR_ID = "bfe35205f026786ea1d56e3b"
-- tVaults[roomid] = { name = "AM", items = {...}, raw = "...", updated = os.time() } tVaults = {} sCurrentRoomID = "" sActiveTab = "" -- roomid of the currently selected tab bWindowVisible = true
-- capture state local bCapturing = false local sCaptureBuffer = "" local sCaptureRoom = "" local sCaptureContainer = "" local sCaptureFullness = "" local iCaptureLines = 0
-- window local win = "VaultTracker_" .. GetPluginID() local winR = "VaultTrackerRes_" .. GetPluginID() local WIN_W, WIN_H = 500, 460 local MIN_W, MIN_H = 280, 180 local SEARCH_H = 24 sSearchQuery = "" local tSearchResults = {} local iWinX, iWinY = 100, 100 local iScroll = 0 local iLineHeight = 14 local iDragStartX, iDragStartY = 0, 0
local BG = ColourNameToRGB("#101010") local FG = ColourNameToRGB("silver") local ACCENT = ColourNameToRGB("orange") local DIM = ColourNameToRGB("#707070") local TABBG = ColourNameToRGB("#202020") local TABON = ColourNameToRGB("#3A2A10") local BORDER = ColourNameToRGB("#404040")
-- *********************** -- ***** Utilities ******* -- ***********************
local function VNote(s) ColourNote("orange", "", "[Vault Tracker] ", "silver", "", s) end
local function Trim(s) return (string.gsub(s, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")) end
-- Find a registered vault by (case-insensitive) name, returns roomid or nil local function FindVaultByName(sName) sName = string.lower(Trim(sName or "")) for roomid, v in pairs(tVaults) do if (string.lower(v.name) == sName) then return roomid end end return nil end
local function VaultCount() local n = 0 for _ in pairs(tVaults) do n = n + 1 end return n end
-- Split "two swords, a hat and a badge" into a list of item strings function ParseItems(s) s = Trim(string.gsub(s, "%.%s*$", "")) local tItems = {} for part in string.gmatch(s, "[^,]+") do table.insert(tItems, Trim(part)) end -- the final comma-part usually holds "X and Y" - split on the LAST " and " if (#tItems > 0) then local sLast = tItems[#tItems] local sBefore, sAfter = string.match(sLast, "^(.*) and (.-)$") if (sBefore ~= nil and sAfter ~= nil and sBefore ~= "" and sAfter ~= "") then tItems[#tItems] = Trim(sBefore) table.insert(tItems, Trim(sAfter)) end end return tItems end
-- Pick a colour for a fullness phrase: green (empty) -> red (full) function FullnessColour(s) s = string.lower(s or "") if (s == "") then return DIM end if (s == "empty") then return ColourNameToRGB("limegreen") end if (string.find(s, "almost completely full", 1, true) ~= nil) then return ColourNameToRGB("orangered") end if (string.find(s, "completely full", 1, true) ~= nil or s == "full") then return ColourNameToRGB("red") end if (string.find(s, "three%-?quarters") ~= nil) then return ColourNameToRGB("orange") end if (string.find(s, "half", 1, true) ~= nil) then return ColourNameToRGB("yellow") end if (string.find(s, "quarter", 1, true) ~= nil) then return ColourNameToRGB("yellowgreen") end return ColourNameToRGB("gold") end
-- Return a copy of the item list sorted alphabetically by the text AFTER -- the first word (the first word is always a quantity: a/an/two/some/...) function SortedItems(tItems) local t = {} for i, s in ipairs(tItems) do t[i] = s end local function SortKey(s) local sRest = string.match(s, "^%S+%s+(.*)$") return string.lower(sRest or s) end table.sort(t, function(a, b) return SortKey(a) < SortKey(b) end) return t end
-- *********************************** -- ***** GMCP room id via CowBar ***** -- ***********************************
bSeenBroadcast = false -- any traffic at all from CowBar (used for diagnostics)
function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, sDataLine) if (id == COWBAR_ID) then bSeenBroadcast = true end if (id == COWBAR_ID and string.sub(sDataLine, 1, 10) == "room.info ") then local bOK, tData = pcall(json.decode, string.sub(sDataLine, 11)) if (bOK and type(tData) == "table" and tData["identifier"] ~= nil) then if (sCurrentRoomID ~= tData["identifier"]) then -- moving rooms cancels any half-finished capture AbortCapture() end sCurrentRoomID = tData["identifier"] end end end
-- Explain why we have no room id, tailored to what we can actually detect function ExplainNoRoomID() ColourNote("red", "", "[Vault Tracker] I don't know which room you are in, so I can't register a vault here.") if (GetPluginInfo(COWBAR_ID, 1) == nil) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Vault Tracker] Quow's CowBar (minimap) plugin isn't installed - VaultTracker needs it") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Vault Tracker] for room detection. Install it, then try again.") elseif (bSeenBroadcast == false) then ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Vault Tracker] CowBar is installed but hasn't sent any data, so its rebroadcast is") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Vault Tracker] probably switched off. Fix it like this:") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Vault Tracker] RIGHT-CLICK the minimap -> tick 'Re-Broadcast GMCP Data'") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Vault Tracker] Then walk one room and type 'vault register <name>' again.") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Vault Tracker] (One-time setting - CowBar remembers it.)") else ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Vault Tracker] CowBar is talking to me, but hasn't reported a room id yet - some rooms") ColourNote("yellow", "", "[Vault Tracker] send no GMCP data. Walk one room (or step out and back in), then try again.") end end
-- **************************** -- ***** Contents capture ***** -- ****************************
function AbortCapture() bCapturing = false sCaptureBuffer = "" sCaptureRoom = "" sCaptureContainer = "" sCaptureFullness = "" iCaptureLines = 0 EnableTrigger("VaultCaptureLine", false) end
local function CommitCapture() local roomid = sCaptureRoom local sRaw = sCaptureBuffer local sContainer = sCaptureContainer local sFullness = sCaptureFullness AbortCapture() if (tVaults[roomid] == nil) then return end local bNewLock = (tVaults[roomid].container == nil or tVaults[roomid].container == "") if (bNewLock) then VNote("Locked '" .. tVaults[roomid].name .. "' to container '" .. sContainer .. "' - other containers in this room are now ignored ('vault unlock' to re-bind).") end tVaults[roomid].items = ParseItems(sRaw) tVaults[roomid].raw = sRaw tVaults[roomid].container = sContainer tVaults[roomid].fullness = sFullness tVaults[roomid].updated = os.time() SaveState() VNote("Updated vault '" .. tVaults[roomid].name .. "' - " .. #tVaults[roomid].items .. " item entries.") if (sActiveTab == "" or tVaults[sActiveTab] == nil) then sActiveTab = roomid end iScroll = 0 DrawVaultWindow() end
function OnVaultContentsStart(name, line, wildcards) if (bCapturing) then return end local v = tVaults[sCurrentRoomID] if (v == nil) then return end -- container lock: once bound, only accept lines from the vault's own container if (v.container ~= nil and v.container ~= "" and v.container ~= wildcards[1]) then return end local sItems, sFullness if (name == "VaultContentsStart") then sFullness = wildcards[2] sItems = wildcards[3] else -- "contains" variant has no fullness phrase sFullness = "" sItems = wildcards[2] end bCapturing = true sCaptureRoom = sCurrentRoomID sCaptureContainer = wildcards[1] sCaptureFullness = sFullness sCaptureBuffer = sItems iCaptureLines = 0 if (string.match(line, "%.%s*$") ~= nil) then CommitCapture() else -- list continues on following lines until one ends with a full stop EnableTrigger("VaultCaptureLine", true) end end
function OnVaultCaptureLine(name, line, wildcards) if (bCapturing == false) then return end local sLine = Trim(wildcards[1]) iCaptureLines = iCaptureLines + 1 if (sLine == "" or iCaptureLines > 15) then -- ran off the end of the list without a full stop; keep what we have CommitCapture() return end sCaptureBuffer = sCaptureBuffer .. " " .. sLine if (string.match(sLine, "%.%s*$") ~= nil) then CommitCapture() end end
function OnVaultEmpty(name, line, wildcards) if (bCapturing) then return end local v = tVaults[sCurrentRoomID] if (v == nil) then return end if (v.container ~= nil and v.container ~= "" and v.container ~= wildcards[1]) then return end tVaults[sCurrentRoomID].items = {} tVaults[sCurrentRoomID].raw = "" tVaults[sCurrentRoomID].container = wildcards[1] tVaults[sCurrentRoomID].fullness = "empty" tVaults[sCurrentRoomID].updated = os.time() SaveState() VNote("Vault '" .. tVaults[sCurrentRoomID].name .. "' recorded as empty.") DrawVaultWindow() end
-- ******************* -- ***** Aliases ***** -- *******************
function OnVaultAlias(name, line, wildcards) local sCmd = string.lower(wildcards[1] or "") local sArg = Trim(wildcards[2] or "")
if (sCmd == "register") then if (sArg == "") then VNote("Usage: vault register <name> (stand in the vault room first)") return end if (sCurrentRoomID == "") then ExplainNoRoomID() return end local sOld = FindVaultByName(sArg) if (sOld ~= nil and sOld ~= sCurrentRoomID) then VNote("A vault named '" .. sArg .. "' is already registered to another room. Use 'vault forget " .. sArg .. "' first.") return end if (tVaults[sCurrentRoomID] ~= nil) then tVaults[sCurrentRoomID].name = sArg VNote("Renamed this room's vault to '" .. sArg .. "'.") else tVaults[sCurrentRoomID] = { name = sArg, items = nil, raw = "", updated = nil } VNote("Registered vault '" .. sArg .. "' in room '" .. sCurrentRoomID .. "'. Now look in the container to record its contents.") end sActiveTab = sCurrentRoomID SaveState() DrawVaultWindow()
elseif (sCmd == "forget") then local roomid = FindVaultByName(sArg) if (roomid == nil) then VNote("No vault named '" .. sArg .. "'. See 'vault list'.") return end tVaults[roomid] = nil if (sActiveTab == roomid) then sActiveTab = "" end SaveState() VNote("Forgot vault '" .. sArg .. "'.") DrawVaultWindow()
elseif (sCmd == "list") then if (VaultCount() == 0) then VNote("No vaults registered. Stand in a vault room and type: vault register <name>") return end VNote("Registered vaults:") for roomid, v in pairs(tVaults) do local sInfo = "(no contents recorded yet)" if (v.items ~= nil) then sInfo = #v.items .. " item entries, updated " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", v.updated) end if (v.container ~= nil and v.container ~= "") then sInfo = sInfo .. " locked to '" .. v.container .. "'" else sInfo = sInfo .. " (UNLOCKED - next look binds)" end ColourNote("orange", "", " " .. v.name, "silver", "", " [" .. roomid .. "] " .. sInfo) end
elseif (sCmd == "show") then local roomid = (sArg ~= "" and FindVaultByName(sArg)) or sActiveTab if (roomid == nil or roomid == "" or tVaults[roomid] == nil) then VNote("No such vault. See 'vault list'.") return end local v = tVaults[roomid] if (v.items == nil) then VNote("'" .. v.name .. "' has no recorded contents yet - go look in it.") return end VNote("Contents of '" .. v.name .. "' (" .. #v.items .. " entries, updated " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", v.updated) .. "):") if (v.fullness ~= nil and v.fullness ~= "") then ColourNote("yellow", "", " " .. (v.container or "Container") .. " is " .. v.fullness .. ".") end for _, sItem in ipairs(SortedItems(v.items)) do ColourNote("silver", "", " " .. sItem) end
elseif (sCmd == "find") then if (sArg == "") then VNote("Usage: vault find <text>") return end local sSearch = string.lower(sArg) local iHits = 0 for roomid, v in pairs(tVaults) do if (v.items ~= nil) then for _, sItem in ipairs(v.items) do if (string.find(string.lower(sItem), sSearch, 1, true) ~= nil) then ColourNote("orange", "", " [" .. v.name .. "] ", "silver", "", sItem) iHits = iHits + 1 end end end end VNote(iHits .. " match(es) for '" .. sArg .. "'.")
elseif (sCmd == "unlock") then local roomid = (sArg ~= "" and FindVaultByName(sArg)) or sActiveTab if (roomid == nil or roomid == "" or tVaults[roomid] == nil) then VNote("No such vault. See 'vault list'.") return end tVaults[roomid].container = "" SaveState() VNote("Unlocked '" .. tVaults[roomid].name .. "'. CAREFUL: the next container you look in while in that room will become its new bound container.")
elseif (sCmd == "window") then bWindowVisible = not bWindowVisible if (not bWindowVisible) then CloseSearchResults() end SaveState() DrawVaultWindow() VNote("Window " .. (bWindowVisible and "shown." or "hidden."))
else -- help / bare "vault" VNote("Commands:") ColourNote("orange", "", " vault register <name>", "silver", "", " - register the room you are standing in as a vault") ColourNote("orange", "", " vault list", "silver", "", " - list registered vaults") ColourNote("orange", "", " vault show [name]", "silver", "", " - print a vault's contents to the output window") ColourNote("orange", "", " vault find <text>", "silver", "", " - search all vaults for an item") ColourNote("orange", "", " vault window", "silver", "", " - show/hide the miniwindow") ColourNote("orange", "", " vault unlock [name]", "silver", "", " - re-bind a vault to a different container") ColourNote("orange", "", " vault forget <name>", "silver", "", " - unregister a vault") VNote("Then just look in the container while standing in a registered vault room and the contents update automatically.") end end
-- ********************** -- ***** Miniwindow ***** -- **********************
-- bResizing: called live during a resize drag - repaint only, do NOT recreate -- the window or touch hotspots (that would kill the active drag handler) function DrawVaultWindow(bResizing) if (bWindowVisible == false or VaultCount() == 0) then if (WindowInfo(win, 1) ~= nil) then WindowShow(win, false) end return end
if (bResizing) then WindowResize(win, WIN_W, WIN_H, BG) else WindowCreate(win, iWinX, iWinY, WIN_W, WIN_H, 4, 2, BG) WindowSetZOrder(win, 999) -- CowBar uses 1..N, keep us above all of it end WindowFont(win, "f", "Lucida Console", 9, false, false, false, false) WindowFont(win, "fb", "Lucida Console", 9, true, false, false, false) iLineHeight = WindowFontInfo(win, "f", 1) + 2 if (not bResizing) then WindowDeleteAllHotspots(win) end WindowRectOp(win, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, BG) WindowRectOp(win, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, BORDER)
-- title bar local TITLE_H = 22 WindowRectOp(win, 2, 1, 1, WIN_W - 1, TITLE_H, TABBG) WindowText(win, "fb", "Vault Tracker", 8, 5, WIN_W - 30, TITLE_H, ACCENT) WindowText(win, "fb", "X", WIN_W - 16, 5, WIN_W - 4, TITLE_H, DIM) if (not bResizing) then WindowAddHotspot(win, "close", WIN_W - 20, 1, WIN_W - 1, TITLE_H, "", "", "", "", "VaultCloseClick", "Hide window (re-open with 'vault window')", 1, 0) WindowAddHotspot(win, "drag", 1, 1, WIN_W - 20, TITLE_H, "", "", "VaultDragMouseDown", "", "", "Drag to move", 10, 0) WindowDragHandler(win, "drag", "VaultDragMove", "VaultDragRelease", 0) end
-- tabs local TAB_Y, TAB_H = TITLE_H + 2, 20 local x = 4 -- stable tab order: sort by name local tOrder = {} for roomid in pairs(tVaults) do table.insert(tOrder, roomid) end table.sort(tOrder, function(a, b) return string.lower(tVaults[a].name) < string.lower(tVaults[b].name) end) if (sActiveTab == "" or tVaults[sActiveTab] == nil) then sActiveTab = tOrder[1] end
for _, roomid in ipairs(tOrder) do local v = tVaults[roomid] local sLabel = v.name if (v.items ~= nil) then sLabel = sLabel .. " (" .. #v.items .. ")" end local w = WindowTextWidth(win, "f", sLabel) + 12 + 12 -- extra room for the fullness dot -- wrap to a new tab row if this one is full if (x > 4 and x + w > WIN_W - 4) then x = 4 TAB_Y = TAB_Y + TAB_H + 2 end local bActive = (roomid == sActiveTab) WindowRectOp(win, 2, x, TAB_Y, x + w, TAB_Y + TAB_H, bActive and TABON or TABBG) WindowRectOp(win, 1, x, TAB_Y, x + w, TAB_Y + TAB_H, bActive and ACCENT or BORDER) -- fullness dot (hollow grey until a fullness has been recorded) local iDotCY = TAB_Y + math.floor(TAB_H / 2) if (v.fullness ~= nil and v.fullness ~= "") then local iDotCol = FullnessColour(v.fullness) WindowCircleOp(win, 2, x + 5, iDotCY - 4, x + 13, iDotCY + 4, iDotCol, 0, 1, iDotCol, 0) else WindowCircleOp(win, 2, x + 5, iDotCY - 4, x + 13, iDotCY + 4, DIM, 0, 1, 0, 1) end WindowText(win, "f", sLabel, x + 17, TAB_Y + 4, x + w, TAB_Y + TAB_H, bActive and ACCENT or FG) if (not bResizing) then WindowAddHotspot(win, "tab:" .. roomid, x, TAB_Y, x + w, TAB_Y + TAB_H, "", "", "", "", "VaultTabClick", "Show " .. v.name, 1, 0) end x = x + w + 3 end
-- info line, fullness line, items local INFO_Y = TAB_Y + TAB_H + 4 local BODY_Y = INFO_Y + iLineHeight + 4 local v = tVaults[sActiveTab] if (v ~= nil) then local sInfo if (v.items == nil) then sInfo = "No contents recorded - go to the vault and look in the container." else sInfo = #v.items .. " item entries - updated " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", v.updated) end WindowText(win, "f", sInfo, 8, INFO_Y, WIN_W - 8, INFO_Y + iLineHeight, DIM) if (v.fullness ~= nil and v.fullness ~= "") then local sFullLine = (v.container or "Container") .. " is " .. v.fullness .. "." WindowText(win, "fb", sFullLine, 8, BODY_Y, WIN_W - 8, BODY_Y + iLineHeight, FullnessColour(v.fullness)) BODY_Y = BODY_Y + iLineHeight + 4 end WindowLine(win, 4, BODY_Y - 2, WIN_W - 4, BODY_Y - 2, BORDER, 0, 1)
if (v.items ~= nil) then local tShow = SortedItems(v.items) local iBodyBottom = WIN_H - SEARCH_H - 6 local iVisible = math.floor((iBodyBottom - BODY_Y) / iLineHeight) local iMax = math.max(0, #tShow - iVisible) if (iScroll > iMax) then iScroll = iMax end if (iScroll < 0) then iScroll = 0 end local y = BODY_Y + 2 for i = iScroll + 1, math.min(#tShow, iScroll + iVisible) do WindowText(win, "f", tShow[i], 8, y, WIN_W - 24, y + iLineHeight, FG) y = y + iLineHeight end -- scroll indicators (kept clear of the search bar and resize grip) if (iMax > 0) then WindowText(win, "fb", "^", WIN_W - 16, BODY_Y + 2, WIN_W - 4, BODY_Y + 2 + iLineHeight, (iScroll > 0) and ACCENT or DIM) WindowText(win, "fb", "v", WIN_W - 16, iBodyBottom - iLineHeight, WIN_W - 4, iBodyBottom, (iScroll < iMax) and ACCENT or DIM) if (not bResizing) then WindowAddHotspot(win, "scrollup", WIN_W - 20, BODY_Y, WIN_W - 1, BODY_Y + 20, "", "", "", "", "VaultScrollUpClick", "Scroll up", 1, 0) WindowAddHotspot(win, "scrolldown", WIN_W - 20, iBodyBottom - 20, WIN_W - 1, iBodyBottom, "", "", "", "", "VaultScrollDownClick", "Scroll down", 1, 0) end end if (not bResizing) then WindowAddHotspot(win, "body", 1, BODY_Y, WIN_W - 21, iBodyBottom, "", "", "", "", "", "", 0, 0) WindowScrollwheelHandler(win, "body", "VaultWheel") end end end
-- search bar along the bottom (click to type a query) local SB_TOP = WIN_H - SEARCH_H WindowRectOp(win, 2, 4, SB_TOP, WIN_W - 20, WIN_H - 4, TABBG) WindowRectOp(win, 1, 4, SB_TOP, WIN_W - 20, WIN_H - 4, BORDER) local sHint if (sSearchQuery ~= "") then sHint = "Search: " .. sSearchQuery else sHint = "Click to search all vaults..." end WindowText(win, "f", sHint, 10, SB_TOP + 4, WIN_W - 24, WIN_H - 4, (sSearchQuery ~= "") and FG or DIM) if (not bResizing) then WindowAddHotspot(win, "searchbar", 4, SB_TOP, WIN_W - 20, WIN_H - 4, "", "", "", "", "VaultSearchClick", "Search all vaults", 2, 0) end
-- resize grip (bottom-right corner) for i = 4, 12, 4 do WindowLine(win, WIN_W - i - 2, WIN_H - 2, WIN_W - 2, WIN_H - i - 2, DIM, 0, 1) end if (not bResizing) then WindowAddHotspot(win, "zzresize", WIN_W - 16, WIN_H - 16, WIN_W - 1, WIN_H - 1, "", "", "VaultResizeMouseDown", "", "", "Drag to resize", 6, 0) WindowDragHandler(win, "zzresize", "VaultResizeMove", "VaultResizeRelease", 0) end
WindowShow(win, true) end
-- ************************** -- ***** Search feature ***** -- **************************
function CloseSearchResults() if (WindowInfo(winR, 1) ~= nil) then WindowShow(winR, false) end end
function VaultSearchClick(flags, id) local s = utils.inputbox("Search all vaults for:", "Vault Tracker", sSearchQuery or "") if (s == nil) then return end -- cancelled sSearchQuery = Trim(s) if (sSearchQuery == "") then CloseSearchResults() DrawVaultWindow() return end local q = string.lower(sSearchQuery) tSearchResults = {} for roomid, v in pairs(tVaults) do if (v.items ~= nil) then for _, sItem in ipairs(v.items) do if (string.find(string.lower(sItem), q, 1, true) ~= nil) then table.insert(tSearchResults, { item = sItem, roomid = roomid }) end end end end table.sort(tSearchResults, function(a, b) return string.lower(a.item) < string.lower(b.item) end) DrawVaultWindow() DrawSearchResults() end
-- Results panel: bottom-left corner anchored to the main window's bottom-right -- corner, so it grows upwards and rightwards function DrawSearchResults() local MAXROWS = 25 local n = #tSearchResults local tRows = {} for i = 1, math.min(n, MAXROWS) do local r = tSearchResults[i] tRows[i] = r.item .. " (" .. (tVaults[r.roomid] and tVaults[r.roomid].name or "?") .. ")" end local sTitle = n .. " match(es) for '" .. sSearchQuery .. "'" if (n > MAXROWS) then sTitle = sTitle .. ", showing " .. MAXROWS end -- measure with the main window's font (same face/size) local wMax = WindowTextWidth(win, "fb", sTitle) + 24 for _, sRow in ipairs(tRows) do local w = WindowTextWidth(win, "f", sRow) + 16 if (w > wMax) then wMax = w end end local W = math.min(wMax, 700) local iRows = math.max(#tRows, 1) -- room for "No matches." when empty local H = (iRows * iLineHeight) + iLineHeight + 16 local iLeft = iWinX + WIN_W + 2 local iTop = iWinY + WIN_H - H if (iTop < 0) then iTop = 0 end
WindowCreate(winR, iLeft, iTop, W, H, 4, 2, BG) WindowSetZOrder(winR, 1000) WindowFont(winR, "f", "Lucida Console", 9, false, false, false, false) WindowFont(winR, "fb", "Lucida Console", 9, true, false, false, false) WindowDeleteAllHotspots(winR) WindowRectOp(winR, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, BG) WindowRectOp(winR, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, ACCENT)
WindowText(winR, "fb", sTitle, 6, 4, W - 20, 4 + iLineHeight, ACCENT) WindowText(winR, "fb", "X", W - 14, 4, W - 2, 4 + iLineHeight, DIM) WindowAddHotspot(winR, "closeres", W - 18, 0, W - 1, 6 + iLineHeight, "", "", "", "", "VaultResultsClose", "Close results", 1, 0)
local y = 10 + iLineHeight if (#tRows == 0) then WindowText(winR, "f", "No matches.", 6, y, W - 6, y + iLineHeight, DIM) else for i, sRow in ipairs(tRows) do if (i % 2 == 0) then WindowRectOp(winR, 2, 2, y, W - 2, y + iLineHeight, TABBG) end WindowText(winR, "f", sRow, 6, y, W - 6, y + iLineHeight, FG) WindowAddHotspot(winR, "res:" .. i, 2, y, W - 2, y + iLineHeight, "", "", "", "", "VaultResultClick", "Go to this vault's tab", 1, 0) y = y + iLineHeight end end WindowShow(winR, true) end
function VaultResultClick(flags, id) local r = tSearchResults[tonumber(string.sub(id, 5)) or 0] CloseSearchResults() if (r == nil or tVaults[r.roomid] == nil) then return end sActiveTab = r.roomid iScroll = 0 DrawVaultWindow() end
function VaultResultsClose(flags, id) CloseSearchResults() end
-- window callbacks function VaultCloseClick(flags, id) bWindowVisible = false CloseSearchResults() SaveState() DrawVaultWindow() end
function VaultTabClick(flags, id) sActiveTab = string.sub(id, 5) iScroll = 0 DrawVaultWindow() end
function VaultScrollUpClick(flags, id) iScroll = iScroll - 5 DrawVaultWindow() end
function VaultScrollDownClick(flags, id) iScroll = iScroll + 5 DrawVaultWindow() end
function VaultWheel(flags, id) if (bit.band(flags, 0x100) ~= 0) then iScroll = iScroll + 3 else iScroll = iScroll - 3 end DrawVaultWindow() end
function VaultDragMouseDown(flags, id) CloseSearchResults() iDragStartX, iDragStartY = WindowInfo(win, 14), WindowInfo(win, 15) end
function VaultDragMove(flags, id) local posx, posy = WindowInfo(win, 17), WindowInfo(win, 18) iWinX, iWinY = posx - iDragStartX, posy - iDragStartY WindowPosition(win, iWinX, iWinY, 0, 2) end
function VaultDragRelease(flags, id) SaveState() end
local iResizeStartX, iResizeStartY, iResizeStartW, iResizeStartH = 0, 0, 0, 0
function VaultResizeMouseDown(flags, id) CloseSearchResults() iResizeStartX, iResizeStartY = WindowInfo(win, 17), WindowInfo(win, 18) iResizeStartW, iResizeStartH = WIN_W, WIN_H end
function VaultResizeMove(flags, id) local mx, my = WindowInfo(win, 17), WindowInfo(win, 18) local newW = math.max(MIN_W, iResizeStartW + (mx - iResizeStartX)) local newH = math.max(MIN_H, iResizeStartH + (my - iResizeStartY)) if (newW ~= WIN_W or newH ~= WIN_H) then WIN_W, WIN_H = newW, newH DrawVaultWindow(true) -- repaint only, keep hotspots/drag alive end end
function VaultResizeRelease(flags, id) SaveState() DrawVaultWindow() -- full rebuild so hotspots match the new size end
-- ***************************** -- ***** State persistence ***** -- *****************************
function OnPluginSaveState() SetVariable("vault_data", serialize.save_simple(tVaults)) SetVariable("win_x", iWinX) SetVariable("win_y", iWinY) SetVariable("win_w", WIN_W) SetVariable("win_h", WIN_H) SetVariable("win_visible", bWindowVisible and "1" or "0") SetVariable("active_tab", sActiveTab) end
function OnPluginInstall() local s = GetVariable("vault_data") if (s ~= nil and s ~= "") then local f = loadstring("return " .. s) if (f ~= nil) then local bOK, t = pcall(f) if (bOK and type(t) == "table") then tVaults = t end end end iWinX = tonumber(GetVariable("win_x")) or 100 iWinY = tonumber(GetVariable("win_y")) or 100 WIN_W = math.max(MIN_W, tonumber(GetVariable("win_w")) or 500) WIN_H = math.max(MIN_H, tonumber(GetVariable("win_h")) or 460) bWindowVisible = (GetVariable("win_visible") ~= "0") sActiveTab = GetVariable("active_tab") or ""
if (GetPluginInfo(COWBAR_ID, 1) == nil) then VNote("WARNING: Quow's CowBar (minimap) plugin not found - room detection needs its GMCP rebroadcast.") end VNote("Loaded. Type 'vault help' for commands.") DrawVaultWindow() end
function OnPluginConnect() bSeenBroadcast = false end
function OnPluginClose() if (WindowInfo(win, 1) ~= nil) then WindowDelete(win) end if (WindowInfo(winR, 1) ~= nil) then WindowDelete(winR) end end
function OnPluginDisable() if (WindowInfo(win, 1) ~= nil) then WindowShow(win, false) end CloseSearchResults() end
function OnPluginEnable() DrawVaultWindow() end
